content: encoding/json/v2 timeline: experiment GOEXPERIMENT=jsonv2 in Go 1.25 (Aug 2025), still off in Go 1.26 (Feb 2026, perf work pending), on by default and in stdlib as encoding/json/v2 in Go 1.27 (Aug 2026) with v1 reimplemented on the v2 engine. v2 is stricter (rejects duplicate keys, invalid UTF-8). Both v1 and v2 sort map keys, so JSON dumps are deterministic either way; keeping the v1 API is the zero-risk choice for on-disk format stability.
